sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

One of the key mechanics is the ability to change the color of the balls by combining them with other balls of the same color. This creates a chain reaction that allows you to clear the screen and earn points.

The game also features special power-ups and bonuses that can be used to enhance your gameplay experience. These include speed boosts, color changing balls, and balls that can clear entire rows or columns. The game's physics engine is also well-designed, making it easy to predict the trajectory of the balls and plan your next move.

As you progress through the levels, the game becomes increasingly difficult, with new obstacles and challenges appearing regularly.
